title: They look nice
text: They look nice. All steel is not good steel. This set of flatware looks nice, but is kind of flimsy. It's not hardened steel. Don't try to dig ice cream (my test for flatware quality) you will bend your spoon completely out of shape. We will be using these in our camper, so I'm not too worried about the poor quality. I would never use it for every day use though, it is just not sturdy enough. Be warned.
